object_description: horizontal strip with a distinct multipurpose block
design_condition: The strip follows the urban edge, but its horizontal response does not adequately address the sloping terrain or establish precise alignments with existing buildings; the crossing path generates poorly defined residual green space.

positive.statement: The positioning of the multipurpose block in relation to the green spaces is interesting.
The modular spaces and movement of the cross section give the architecture quality.
The spaces demonstrate a correct use of natural light.
The internal gym spaces are functional and well organized.

negative.statement: The first-stage building does not establish precise reference alignments with the existing buildings.
The pedestrian route does not relate convincingly to the context, and the residual green area has an unconvincing function.
The horizontal design does not respond satisfactorily to the sloping terrain.
The proposed embankment is architecturally underdeveloped and obstructs the relationship between the street and the gymnasium.
The construction system retains the unresolved problems previously identified by the jury.
